# HostFi

> AI-powered expense management built specifically for short-term rental (STR) operators, Airbnb hosts, VRBO managers, and rental arbitrage operators.

## What HostFi Does

HostFi is a web-based SaaS platform that helps rental property operators track expenses, scan receipts, parse bills with AI, detect anomalies, and prepare IRS Schedule E tax reports. It integrates with major property management systems (PMS) and banking platforms.

## Key Features

- AI Bill Parsing: Forward bills to a unique email address. AI extracts amount, due date, vendor, category, and matches to the correct property.
- Receipt Scanning: Upload or photograph receipts. AI reads, categorizes, and files them.
- Schedule E Tax Prep: Every expense auto-mapped to IRS Schedule E line items. Supports both property owner and arbitrage operator tax mappings.
- Anomaly Detection: Automatic alerts when expenses spike unexpectedly (water leaks, rate increases, billing errors).
- Revenue & P/L Tracking: Import revenue from Airbnb, VRBO, Booking.com, or direct bookings. See true profit per property.
- Bank Sync via Plaid: Connect bank accounts to auto-import and categorize transactions.
- Ask AI: Query your financial data in plain English ("What did I spend on utilities last quarter?").
- Cross-Property Benchmarking: Compare costs across your portfolio to identify inefficiencies.

## Integrations

PMS: Guesty, Hostaway, OwnerRez, Hospitable, Hospitable Connect, Lodgify
Banking: Plaid (direct bank sync)
Productivity: Google Sheets, Google Drive, Slack, Zapier, Make
Coming Soon: QuickBooks, Xero, Melio, Dropbox, Microsoft Teams

## Pricing

- Free: Up to 3 properties, 3 receipt scans/month, core expense tracking
- Pro ($15/month): Up to 10 properties, unlimited receipt scans, AI features, PMS integrations, Schedule E tax prep, P/L exports
- Business ($49/month): Up to 25 properties, team access, benchmarking, priority support

## Target Users

- Short-term rental hosts (Airbnb, VRBO)
- Rental arbitrage operators
- Vacation rental property managers
- Multi-property landlords who also operate STRs

## How It Compares

- vs Stessa: Stessa is built for long-term rental investors. HostFi is built for STR operators with variable income, cleaning fees, platform fees, and higher expense volume.
- vs QuickBooks: QuickBooks is general-purpose accounting. HostFi is purpose-built for rental properties with auto Schedule E mapping and PMS integrations.
- vs Landlord Studio: Landlord Studio focuses on traditional landlording. HostFi focuses on short-term rental operations.
- vs Spreadsheets: HostFi automates categorization, tax mapping, and anomaly detection that spreadsheets require manual formulas for.
